slots.description: Find a memorable Bob's Burgers inspired gift for birthdays, anniversaries, couples, families, and friends with a hand-drawn custom portrait.
slots.intro: A thoughtful Bob's Burgers inspired gift should feel personal, funny, and full of the recipient's personality. A custom portrait turns a favourite family, couple, pet, or group of friends into original cartoon characters with cozy burger-shop energy, expressive faces, and a setting made for them. At Anime Cabinet, human artists hand-draw every portrait rather than applying an AI filter. Browse the [Custom Bob's Burgers Portrait](/portraits/bobs-burgers) page to order, or read our [Bob's Burgers-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/bobs-burgers-inspired-custom-poster) for a closer look at the process.
